note: The delayed-reward suite. Every position has a winning line for the player to move that an exhaustive search over that player's own decisions for the turn found, that the frozen heuristic does not find on any of the seeds agents are scored on, and that uniform random play does not stumble into on more than a quarter of them. 'max_turns' is the horizon, in the searched player's own turns: 1 means the line wins inside the searched turn, 2 means it cannot — it has to leave a board the frozen policy converts a turn later, with the rival answering in between, which is the delayed reward the training plan claims to teach. Only the searched turn is ever chosen, by the solver and by a scored agent alike; every later turn on both sides is the frozen policy. Positions are data with their verification attached; cptcg.learn.delayed.verify_suite re-derives all of it, and tests/learn/test_delayed_reward.py fails if a stored claim stops being true.
